meta_description:
techhelpindia on September 16, 2026: "UPI payment par charge lagega? 👀

15 October 2026 se UPI ko lekar ek claim viral ho raha hai, lekin har UPI payment par charge nahi lagne wala.

₹2,000 ho ya ₹2 lakh — friends & family ko kiya gaya normal UPI transfer free rahega. 💸

Toh exactly charge kahan lagega, kitna lagega aur kisko dena padega?
Video ko end tak dekho aur ye information kisi UPI user ke saath share karo.

#UPI #UPIPayment #UPICharges #DigitalPayment #technews".
